newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil deputies OK re-election without resignation.
newsitem.headline: Brazil deputies OK re-election without resignation.

text.p: Brazil's Chamber of Deputies rejected a proposal that President Fernando Henrique Cardoso would have step down six months before standing for re-election, a legislative whip said.

The proposed change was floated by opposition deputies for inclusion in a constitutional amendment given its first approval in the lower house on Tuesday but was defeated, deputy Jose Anibal, leader of Cardoso's Brazilian Social Democratic Party said.
